paragraphs.p0: Most AI tools stop at thinking. We built one that acts.
paragraphs.p1: Dobby is an AI agent that doesn't just give you answers—it gets things done. Research, code, write, manage projects, execute workflows. The whole job.
paragraphs.p2: We started with a simple problem: people spend too much time on execution and not enough on the work that actually moves things forward.
paragraphs.p3: So we built an AI that handles the doing. The research. The drafts. The code. The follow-through. All the stuff that fills your day but doesn't define your value.
paragraphs.p4: This isn't about replacing people. It's about freeing them. Give the grunt work to AI. Keep the strategy, creativity, and decisions for yourself.
paragraphs.p5: We're not chasing hype. We're building something reliable enough to trust with real work. Something that ships. Something that works when you need it to.
paragraphs.p6: The goal is simple: make everyone 10x more capable by giving them an AI teammate that never sleeps, never complains, and always executes.
paragraphs.hiringLead: Want to build it with us?

creditsExplainedPage.subtitle: Tudo o que precisas saber sobre como os créditos funcionam no Dobby

understandingCredits.title: Entendendo Créditos
understandingCredits.description: Os créditos servem como moeda universal do Dobby para operações da plataforma. Cada ação que teus agentes de IA executam—de analisar dados a gerar código—consome créditos com base na complexidade da tarefa e nos recursos necessários.

howCreditsWork.title: Como os Créditos Funcionam
howCreditsWork.description: Os créditos são consumidos com base nos recursos que teus agentes de IA usam:

aiModelUsage.title: Uso do Modelo de IA
aiModelUsage.description: O principal fator de consumo de créditos
aiModelUsage.content: Diferentes modelos de IA têm custos diferentes com base em suas capacidades e uso de tokens. Os créditos são consumidos para tokens de entrada (teus prompts e contexto), tokens de saída (respostas do agente) e variam por nível do modelo (Claude, GPT, etc.).

pricingModel.title: Modelo de Preços
pricingModel.description: Margem de 20% sobre os custos do modelo de IA
pricingModel.content: Aplicamos uma margem de 20% em todos os custos de API e modelo para cobrir infraestrutura da plataforma, segurança e desenvolvimento contínuo. Este preço transparente garante que saibas exatamente pelo que estás pagando.

gettingMoreCredits.title: Obtendo Mais Créditos
gettingMoreCredits.description: Existem várias formas de obter créditos no Dobby:

monthlySubscription.title: Créditos de Assinatura Mensal
monthlySubscription.description: Incluídos no teu plano pago e renovados automaticamente a cada mês. Estes são créditos com expiração.

topUpCredits.title: Créditos de Recarga
topUpCredits.description: Compra créditos adicionais quando precisares. Estes não expiram e estão disponíveis para membros premium.

promotionalGrants.title: Concessões Promocionais e de Eventos
promotionalGrants.description: Créditos bônus de eventos especiais, promoções ou indicações. Estes não expiram.

refunds.title: Reembolsos
refunds.description: Créditos devolvidos devido a problemas técnicos ou tarefas falhadas. Estes não expiram.

typesOfCredits.title: Tipos de Créditos
typesOfCredits.description: O Dobby usa dois tipos de créditos para te dar flexibilidade em como geres teu uso:

expiringCredits.title: Créditos com Expiração
expiringCredits.content: Estes créditos estão incluídos na tua assinatura paga e são renovados automaticamente a cada mês na data da tua assinatura. Eles expiram no final de cada ciclo de cobrança e são sempre consumidos primeiro antes de quaisquer créditos sem expiração.

nonExpiringCredits.title: Créditos sem Expiração
nonExpiringCredits.content: Estes créditos nunca expiram e são transferidos de mês para mês. Eles incluem compras de recarga, reembolsos e concessões promocionais. Os créditos sem expiração são usados apenas após os teus créditos com expiração serem esgotados.

creditPriority.title: Prioridade de Créditos:
creditPriority.description: Quando usas o Dobby, os créditos com expiração são consumidos primeiro. Apenas após os teus créditos com expiração se esgotarem, os créditos sem expiração serão usados.

resourceUsage.aiActivityText: Processing requests, generating responses, making decisions, and running AI models during task execution.
resourceUsage.dobbyComputerText: The execution environment that powers code execution, browser automation, and interactive task processing.
resourceUsage.fileStorageText: Storing, organizing, and managing files created during your tasks.
resourceUsage.webSearchText: Searching the internet for information, data, and resources needed to complete tasks.
resourceUsage.peopleSearchText: Finding and retrieving information about people, contacts, and professional data.
resourceUsage.thirdPartyText: Accessing external APIs, databases, and integrated services that extend your agent's capabilities.

creditsExplainedPage.afterTaskComplete: Once a task completes, no further credits are consumed. Your completed work, stored files, and deployed projects remain accessible without any ongoing credit costs.
creditsExplainedPage.refundPolicyAlert: If a task fails due to a system error on our side, we'll automatically refund all credits used for that task. We're constantly improving our infrastructure to make credit usage more efficient.
creditsExplainedPage.typesOverviewIntro: Credits fall into two categories: expiring and non-expiring. When you run a task, credits are deducted in this priority order: expiring credits first (daily/weekly, then monthly), followed by non-expiring credits.

typeCards.dailyWeeklyBody: Free tier: 20 credits weekly. Paid tiers: 20 credits daily. Use it or lose it—these credits reset and don't roll over.
typeCards.monthlyBody: Included with your subscription plan. Refresh at the start of each billing cycle and don't roll over.
typeCards.extraBody: Purchased or promotional credits that never expire. Use them anytime—they're always there when you need them.

creditsExplainedPage.expiringDailyWeeklyText: Free tier gets 20 credits weekly. Paid tiers get 20 credits daily. Check your billing page to see when your next refresh happens. Unused credits don't roll over.
creditsExplainedPage.expiringMonthlyText: Your subscription's main credit allocation. These refresh at the start of each billing cycle and don't accumulate—use them within the month.
creditsExplainedPage.expiringPromotionalText: Bonus credits from events or referrals with expiration dates. Use them before they expire.
creditsExplainedPage.nonExpiringTopUpText: Additional credits you purchase when needed. These never expire and are available to premium members.
creditsExplainedPage.nonExpiringPromoGrantsText: Some promotions give credits without expiration dates. These stay in your account forever.
creditsExplainedPage.nonExpiringFreeText: Welcome bonuses and complimentary credits never expire.
creditsExplainedPage.usagePriorityAlertRich: Credit usage priority: When running tasks, we always use your expiring credits first (daily/weekly → monthly) before touching your extra credits. This ensures you get the most value from all your credits.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions

q1.a: Dobby is a generalist AI worker that can perform real-world tasks on your behalf. Unlike traditional AI assistants, Dobby can actually take action across your apps, automate workflows, and handle complex multi-step tasks autonomously.

q2.a: Dobby can automate repetitive tasks, manage your workflows, interact with web services, process data, create content, and coordinate complex operations across multiple platforms. Simply tell Dobby what you need done, and it handles the execution from start to finish.

q3.q: How is Dobby different from other AI platforms?
q3.a: While most AI platforms only provide information or suggestions, Dobby actually performs real-world tasks. It can browse the web, interact with APIs, manage files, execute commands, and integrate with your existing tools to complete tasks autonomously—not just tell you how to do them.

q4.q: Can Dobby connect to my apps?
q4.a: Yes! Dobby can connect to thousands of apps and services through integrations. It can interact with your tools, APIs, databases, and workflows to automate tasks across your entire tech stack. You control which apps and services Dobby can access.

q5.q: How do I request a new feature?
q5.aRich: We love feature requests! Email us at <email>support@dobby.now</email> with details about what you'd like to see and how it would help you. We carefully review all suggestions and prioritize features based on user feedback for our product roadmap.

q6.q: How do I report a bug?
q6.aRich: If you encounter a bug, please email <email>support@dobby.now</email> with a detailed description of the issue, steps to reproduce it, and any error messages you're seeing. Screenshots or screen recordings are extremely helpful. We'll investigate and work on a fix promptly.

q7.q: What if I don't get credits after paying?
q7.aRich: If your credits don't appear after payment, contact <email>support@dobby.now</email> immediately. We prioritize billing and credit issues for all users regardless of tier and will resolve this as quickly as possible, typically within a few hours during business days.

accountDelete.title: Account Deletion
accountDelete.subtitle: How to permanently delete your account
accountDelete.intro: If you'd like to permanently delete your account, you have two options:
accountDelete.option1BodyRich: You can request account deletion by contacting our support team. Simply email us at <email>support@dobby.now</email> with your account deletion request, and we'll process it for you.
accountDelete.option2Intro: If you're logged into your account, you can delete it yourself through your user settings:
accountDelete.step1: Click on your user avatar/profile picture in the top-right corner of the screen
accountDelete.step3Rich: Scroll down to the Delete Account section
accountDelete.step5aRich: 30-Day Grace Period: Your account will be scheduled for deletion in 30 days. You can cancel this request anytime within the grace period.
accountDelete.step5bRich: Immediate Deletion: Your account and all data will be permanently deleted immediately. This action cannot be undone.
accountDelete.step7Rich: Click the final Delete Account button to confirm
accountDelete.note: Note: When you delete your account, all your agents, threads, credentials, subscriptions, and billing data will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone after the grace period expires (if you chose the 30-day option) or immediately (if you chose immediate deletion).
